# telnyx_advanced_number_order (Data Source)

An advanced order for phone numbers, by country, type and features. Orders cannot be cancelled through the API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `area_code` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `customer_reference` (String)
- `features` (Set of String)
- `orders` (List of String)
- `phone_number_type` (String) One of `landline`, `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `quantity` (Number)
- `requirement_group_id` (String) The ID of the requirement group associated with this advanced order
- `status` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
